source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK) — conference agendas and news
why_relevant: BQK publishes full agendas (PDF/HTML) for its annual and anniversary conferences, listing every panellist with title. Agendas are the most precise dated title statements available for regulators and bank executives, and BQK news items also record who represents the CBK abroad — useful for tracking deputy-governor and directorate reshuffles.

source_name: BQK — Trainings and seminars page (currency/banking operations)
why_relevant: Regulator-run training programmes for bank staff (cash handling, counterfeit detection, donor-funded technical training). Attendance requirements and new programme launches indicate compliance-driven headcount and unit changes at the banks that must send staff.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — RISE internship & scholarship programme news
why_relevant: RISE is an explicit university-to-bank pipeline (scholarships + internships for technology/IT students, ~15 per cohort, agile-methodology training). Cohort size and disciplines are a direct, dated signal of planned IT/digital headcount growth at one of Kosovo's largest banks.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — careers / "How to join ProCredit" and Onboarding Programme
why_relevant: ProCredit runs a structured graduate entry route (Onboarding Programme, group training academy) plus mandatory-curriculum student internships of 1-3 months. Openings and cohort announcements are a clean planned-headcount signal; the group-wide HR portal adds a second, comparable feed.

source_name: KosovaJob — bank employer pages (internship / employment programme listings)
why_relevant: Kosovo's dominant job board carries per-employer pages where banks post internship, summer-internship and graduate-programme calls that sometimes never appear on the bank's own site. Acts as an aggregator/archive for the university pipeline half of this cell.

source_name: STIKK (Kosovo ICT Association) — KosICT festival and events archive
why_relevant: KosICT is Kosovo's largest tech event (Tech Park Prishtina; 3,000+ attendees, ~30 speakers incl. international). Banks' digital/IT leaders and fintech founders appear as speakers and sponsors, giving dated title statements for the technology side of banking leadership that never surface in banking-press coverage.

source_name: The Banker (FT) — Bank of the Year Awards, Kosovo country winner
why_relevant: Annual country award. Award citations and the bank's own press release quote the accepting executive by name and title, and the citation text describes strategy shifts (new card offering, sustainability programme) that precede reorganisations. The winner's press release is often more accessible than The Banker's paywalled page.

source_name: Euromoney — Awards for Excellence / Private Banking, Kosovo national winners
why_relevant: Publishes a Kosovo-specific national winners page annually (Awards for Excellence and Private Banking Awards). Citations describe the winning bank's business lines and often name the executives behind them — a dated, third-party-verified statement of who runs what.

source_name: University of Prishtina "Hasan Prishtina" — Career Development Centre (Qendra për Zhvillim të Karrierës)
why_relevant: The official UP unit that brokers internships and employer relations for Kosovo's largest university (est. 2007). Career-fair exhibitor lists, employer MoUs and internship calls name which banks are actively recruiting graduates and in which faculties — the core university-pipeline signal for this cell.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — Global Money Week / Stock Market Learning (SML) Competition
why_relevant: Annual financial-education programme run jointly by KBA and BQK with a student competition (SML) whose winners and mentoring banks are announced publicly. It is the recurring, calendarised student-outreach channel through which Kosovo banks meet future recruits, and the announcements name the bank officers running it.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — LinkedIn page
why_relevant: Fast, photo-caption-rich channel for event and training announcements, often earlier than the website, and the tagging of attendees exposes individual bank staff with current titles. Best used as a discovery pointer to canonical posts on bankassoc-kos.com rather than as a scraped source.

source_name: Telegrafi — event previews and award coverage (sq)
why_relevant: Kosovo's highest-traffic Albanian-language news site systematically previews financial conferences and award ceremonies, naming headline speakers and their titles. Effective as a broad tripwire for events that never get an English page, including regional ICT/finance award winners.

source_name: Dukagjini — financial forum and conference coverage (sq)
why_relevant: Second independent Albanian-language outlet covering the same forum circuit, useful for corroboration and for panel-level detail (which minister/governor/CEO sat on which panel) that the organiser page compresses. Reduces single-source risk on speaker-roster signals.

source_name: AmCham Kosovo — events and press releases (incl. archive site)
why_relevant: AmCham states it runs 100+ activities a year and banks (e.g. BKT Kosova) are members with board and committee seats. Committee membership lists, event photos and press releases identify serving bank executives by title, and board rotations are an early leadership-change indicator. The archive.amcham.network site preserves older press releases.

source_name: AIK Banka — scholarships for students in Kosovo and Metohija (sr)
why_relevant: The only Serbian-language bank-to-student pipeline programme surfaced for the Kosovo territory: AIK Banka awards scholarships to top students in Kosovo and Metohija, i.e. the University of Priština (temporary seat in Kosovska Mitrovica) catchment. Covers the Serb-majority north that Albanian-language sources miss entirely.

source_name: Faculty of Economics, University of Priština (Kosovska Mitrovica) — faculty news and cooperation announcements (sr)
why_relevant: The Serbian-language economics faculty serving northern Kosovo; its internship agreements, guest lectures and graduate placements are the sr-side equivalent of the UP Prishtina career centre. The faculty's own domain was not confirmed in this pass, so this directory entry is recorded as a pointer to reach it.

source_name: BQK list of licensed financial institutions (PDF) — actor-map seed for this cell
why_relevant: Authoritative, periodically reissued roster of every licensed bank, MFI, insurer and payment institution. Not itself an events/awards source, but it is the canonical seed list for enumerating whose careers pages, internship schemes, conference sponsorships and award entries must be tracked in this cell.

source_name: Albanian ICT Awards (ALBICT / ictawards.org) — pan-Albanian technology awards incl. Kosovo entrants
why_relevant: The main regional technology award with Albania, Kosovo and North Macedonia entrants; nominee and winner listings name individuals and their employers, and finance/fintech categories capture digital-banking teams. Award citations are dated title statements usable as weak leadership signals for the tech side of banks.

source_name: Inspektorati i Punës i Republikës së Kosovës (Labour Inspectorate) — official site
why_relevant: Sole executive body supervising labour-relations and OSH law in Kosovo; receives and rules on individual and collective dismissal complaints (documented rulings against ProCredit Bank employees). Publishes notices, inspection campaign results, employer checklists and annual reports — the primary official channel where bank redundancies and wage disputes become visible before employers announce them.

source_name: Inspektorati Qendror (Central Inspectorate) — cross-inspectorate reporting portal
why_relevant: Umbrella body that aggregates and publishes periodic (reportedly ~48-hour cycle) inspection statistics across inspectorates, including the Labour Inspectorate. Useful as a structured, higher-frequency pointer into inspection volumes and enforcement actions by sector.

source_name: BSPK — Bashkimi i Sindikatave të Pavarura të Kosovës (Confederation of Independent Trade Unions of Kosovo)
why_relevant: Kosovo's only ITUC-member union confederation and umbrella for ~20+ branch unions. Statements, press releases and its private-sector affiliate's campaigns are the main organised-labour channel where dismissals, wage disputes and anti-union retaliation in private employers (including banks) surface.

source_name: Sindikata e Pavarur e Sektorit Privat të Kosovës (Independent Union of the Private Sector, led by Jusuf Azemi) — via BSPK and media
source_subtype: union spokesperson coverage / media tag feed
why_relevant: The private-sector union is the only organised labour actor plausibly covering bank employees (there is effectively no dedicated bank-workers' union in Kosovo). Its leader's strike threats and complaint statements are carried by economic media; the 'grevë' tag page is a practical aggregation point for strike signals.

source_name: APRK — Agjencia e Punësimit e Republikës së Kosovës (Employment Agency)
why_relevant: Public employment service administering registered jobseekers, vacancies and active labour-market measures. Registration inflows and vacancy postings by economic activity are the administrative trace of financial-sector layoffs and hiring waves; the agency is also the notification counterparty for collective redundancy procedures.

source_name: SITP — Barometri i Tregut të Punës në Kosovë (Kosovo Labour Market Barometer / Employment Module)
why_relevant: Administrative-data labour-market dashboard combining Civil Registry, Tax Administration, MFLT and APRK records, with breakdowns by economic activity and occupation. This is the closest thing to a machine-readable series for headcount movement in the financial-activities NACE class — the strongest quantitative early-warning input for this cell.

source_name: ASK — Agjencia e Statistikave të Kosovës (Kosovo Agency of Statistics), Labour Force Survey and business statistics
why_relevant: Official statistics producer: Anketa e Fuqisë Punëtore (LFS), registered-employment and structural business statistics by activity. Provides the denominator against which financial-sector headcount changes are judged, and its API host (askapi.rks-gov.net) serves publication files directly.

source_name: Gjykata Themelore në Prishtinë — published judgments (labour and commercial departments)
why_relevant: Kosovo courts publish anonymised judgments as PDFs, including 'kontest pune' (employment disputes) and Economic Department cases involving banks. Wrongful-dismissal and severance judgments naming bank defendants are a hard, citable record of workforce conflict and restructuring.

source_name: Kosovo Judicial Council portal (gjyqesori-rks.org) — court network and case statistics
why_relevant: Central entry point to all Basic Courts, the Court of Appeals and their verdict repositories, plus caseload statistics including employment-dispute backlogs. Pointer for expanding judicial collection beyond Prishtina to Prizren, Peja, Gjilan, Mitrovica.
